# openrouter_generation (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The generation ID (returned as response_id from openrouter_chat_completion).

### Read-Only

- `api_type` (String) API type used (e.g. completions, embeddings).
- `cache_discount` (Number) Discount from caching in USD.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the generation was created.
- `finish_reason` (String) Reason the generation finished.
- `generation_time` (Number) Generation time in milliseconds.
- `is_byok` (Boolean) Whether the request used a Bring Your Own Key configuration.
- `latency` (Number) Total latency in milliseconds.
- `model` (String) Model used for the generation.
- `native_finish_reason` (String) Provider's native finish reason.
- `native_tokens_cached` (Number) Provider-reported cached tokens.
- `native_tokens_completion` (Number) Provider-reported completion tokens.
- `native_tokens_prompt` (Number) Provider-reported prompt tokens.
- `native_tokens_reasoning` (Number) Provider-reported reasoning tokens.
- `num_media_completion` (Number) Number of media items in the completion.
- `num_media_prompt` (Number) Number of media items in the prompt.
- `origin` (String) Origin URL of the request.
- `provider_name` (String) Name of the provider that served the request.
- `router` (String) Router used (e.g. openrouter/auto).
- `tokens_completion` (Number) Number of completion tokens.
- `tokens_prompt` (Number) Number of prompt tokens.
- `total_cost` (Number) Total cost of the generation in USD.
- `upstream_id` (String) Provider's upstream generation ID.
- `upstream_inference_cost` (Number) Cost charged by the upstream provider in USD.
- `usage` (Number) Usage cost in USD.
